title: NVIDIA Hopper GPU 架構
summary: 以SIMT、Transformer Engine 與非同步記憶體解析NVIDIA Hopper GPU 架構：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore NVIDIA Hopper GPU architecture through simt, transformer engine and asynchronous memory: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 原創張量、運算成本及失效分析。架構圖是功能教學示意，非晶片floorplan或專有電路；數字為假想，需依精度、shape、資料分佈與系統邊界重算。
scopeEn: Original tensor, compute-cost and failure analysis. Functional diagrams are not chip floorplans/proprietary circuits; assumed values need recalculation for precision, shape, data and boundaries.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在NVIDIA Hopper GPU 架構案例中比較Hopper warp與SM與FP8矩陣核心，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate hopper warps and sms and fp8 matrix cores within the NVIDIA Hopper GPU architecture case.

steps.title: SIMT 與執行羣：架構分析
steps.titleEn: SIMT and execution groups: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對Hopper warp與SM提出可反駁的SIMT 與執行羣模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable simt and execution groups model and evidence record for hopper warps and sms.
steps.instruction: 在「NVIDIA Hopper GPU 架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Hopper warp與SM。GPU 以線程羣執行指令；分支分歧及記憶存取模式影響利用率。 建立SIMT 與執行羣的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是SIMT、Transformer Engine 與非同步記憶體。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對兩種索引模式比較活躍lane與存取筆數。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify hopper warps and sms in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NVIDIA Hopper GPU architecture. GPU thread groups execute instructions; divergence and access patterns affect utilization. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of simt and execution groups, focusing on simt, transformer engine and asynchronous memory. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare active lanes/accesses for two indexing patterns. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 對兩種索引模式比較活躍lane與存取筆數。
steps.observationEn: Compare active lanes/accesses for two indexing patterns.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有線程數加倍必然使吞吐量加倍。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Doubling threads necessarily doubles throughput.
steps.check: 提交Hopper warp與SM的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for hopper warps and sms.

knowledge.title: SIMT 與執行羣
knowledge.text: GPU 以線程羣執行指令；分支分歧及記憶存取模式影響利用率。 本課架構對應：Hopper warp與SM
knowledge.textEn: GPU thread groups execute instructions; divergence and access patterns affect utilization. Course architecture correspondence: Hopper warps and SMs

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 對兩種索引模式比較活躍lane與存取筆數。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；所有線程數加倍必然使吞吐量加倍。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare active lanes/accesses for two indexing patterns. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Doubling threads necessarily doubles throughput.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設算術強度 I=7 FLOP/byte、頻寬 B=1.0 TB/s、計算峯值 37 TFLOP/s，理想 roofline=min(37,I×B)=7.0 TFLOP/s。皆非產品規格，未含同步、精度轉換或工作形狀損失。
knowledge.textEn: Assume I=7 FLOP/byte, B=1.0 TB/s and compute peak 37 TFLOP/s: ideal roofline min(37,I×B)=7.0 TFLOP/s. These are not product specifications; synchronization, precision conversion and shape inefficiency are omitted.

quiz.question: 就Hopper warp與SM的「SIMT 與執行羣」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for simt and execution groups in hopper warps and sms?
options: GPU 以線程羣執行指令；分支分歧及記憶存取模式影響利用率。
所有線程數加倍必然使吞吐量加倍。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: GPU thread groups execute instructions; divergence and access patterns affect utilization.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: GPU 以線程羣執行指令；分支分歧及記憶存取模式影響利用率。 對兩種索引模式比較活躍lane與存取筆數。
quiz.explanationEn: GPU thread groups execute instructions; divergence and access patterns affect utilization. Compare active lanes/accesses for two indexing patterns.

steps.title: SIMT 與執行羣：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: SIMT and execution groups: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對Hopper warp與SM提出可反駁的SIMT 與執行羣模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable simt and execution groups model and evidence record for hopper warps and sms.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「SIMT 與執行羣」模型，檢查Hopper warp與SM的兩個假想案例。對兩種索引模式比較活躍lane與存取筆數。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分GPU 以線程羣執行指令；分支分歧及記憶存取模式影響利用率。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous simt and execution groups model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving hopper warps and sms. Compare active lanes/accesses for two indexing patterns. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "GPU thread groups execute instructions; divergence and access patterns affect utilization." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 對兩種索引模式比較活躍lane與存取筆數。
steps.observationEn: Compare active lanes/accesses for two indexing patterns.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有線程數加倍必然使吞吐量加倍。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Doubling threads necessarily doubles throughput.
steps.check: 提交Hopper warp與SM的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for hopper warps and sms.

steps.title: 矩陣核心與精度：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Matrix cores and precision: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對FP8矩陣核心提出可反駁的矩陣核心與精度模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable matrix cores and precision model and evidence record for fp8 matrix cores.
steps.instruction: 在「NVIDIA Hopper GPU 架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識FP8矩陣核心。專用矩陣單元以特定精度及shape執行；低精度吞吐量不能當成FP64能力。 建立矩陣核心與精度的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是SIMT、Transformer Engine 與非同步記憶體。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。固定矩陣工作量比較計算誤差及各精度路徑。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify fp8 matrix cores in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NVIDIA Hopper GPU architecture. Matrix units use supported shapes/precisions; low-precision throughput is not FP64 capability. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of matrix cores and precision, focusing on simt, transformer engine and asynchronous memory. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare error and supported paths at fixed matrix workload. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 固定矩陣工作量比較計算誤差及各精度路徑。
steps.observationEn: Compare error and supported paths at fixed matrix workload.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：FP8、FP32、FP64 的峯值可不加標示直接比較。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Unlabeled FP8, FP32 and FP64 peaks are directly comparable.
steps.check: 提交FP8矩陣核心的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for fp8 matrix cores.

knowledge.title: 矩陣核心與精度
knowledge.text: 專用矩陣單元以特定精度及shape執行；低精度吞吐量不能當成FP64能力。 本課架構對應：FP8矩陣核心
knowledge.textEn: Matrix units use supported shapes/precisions; low-precision throughput is not FP64 capability. Course architecture correspondence: FP8 matrix cores

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 固定矩陣工作量比較計算誤差及各精度路徑。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；FP8、FP32、FP64 的峯值可不加標示直接比較。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare error and supported paths at fixed matrix workload. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Unlabeled FP8, FP32 and FP64 peaks are directly comparable.

quiz.question: 就FP8矩陣核心的「矩陣核心與精度」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for matrix cores and precision in fp8 matrix cores?
options: FP8、FP32、FP64 的峯值可不加標示直接比較。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
專用矩陣單元以特定精度及shape執行；低精度吞吐量不能當成FP64能力。
optionsEn: Unlabeled FP8, FP32 and FP64 peaks are directly comparable.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
Matrix units use supported shapes/precisions; low-precision throughput is not FP64 capability.
quiz.explanation: 專用矩陣單元以特定精度及shape執行；低精度吞吐量不能當成FP64能力。 固定矩陣工作量比較計算誤差及各精度路徑。
quiz.explanationEn: Matrix units use supported shapes/precisions; low-precision throughput is not FP64 capability. Compare error and supported paths at fixed matrix workload.

Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
